messages:
Maya: heads up — CI run exposed raw customer prompts in the eval artifacts bucket :eyes:
Liam: which job?
Maya: eval-ci/sandbox-onboard on branch quant/bringup, build 1753001234. saw full prompt in `artifacts/eval-runner/1753001234/request.log`
Maya: log excerpt:
```
REQUEST: {"prompt": "Customer: my secret key is sk-live-... please ignore"}
```
Liam: oof. redaction step should've removed sensitive tokens. @eval-ci-bot what happened to preproc?
Eval-ci-bot: preproc step failed in that run — exit code 124 (timeout). No redaction applied.
Anika: reproduction steps? can we re-run with same inputs in a sandbox that blocks uploads?
Maya: command used: `./scripts/run_eval --model=qp8-slim --mode=onboard --preproc=redaction-v2 --samples=120`
Derek: redaction-v2 has a token-boundary regression when samples > 50 (seen during quant experiments last month). It can skip the tokenizer pass and return original prompt.
Liam: immediate mitigation: block artifact upload for any run where `--preproc` is set but preproc exits nonzero or times out. Also add a CI gate that refuses uploads if artifacts contain matching PII regexes.
Anika: I'll add S3 ACLs to `redwood-eval-sandbox/*` and run a purge of recent objects. Need confirmation on retention policy before purge.
Maya: suggested quick patch for runner config:
```
# eval-runner config override (quickfix)
preprocessors:
  - name: redaction-v2
    fallback: hash-only
    timeout_seconds: 30
    max_samples: 50
```
Liam: long-term: introduce a `--safe-mode` for eval-runner that enforces deterministic hashing of any user-facing tokens, strips prompt prefixes, and never emits raw_input to artifacts. Also wire a unit test that scans produced artifacts for sensitive patterns.
Derek: will add tests. quick unit check example to add to CI:
```
# test_sanitization.py
assert not re.search(r"(sk_live|api_key|\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b|@\S+\.com)", artifact_blob)
```
Maya: PR opened for CI-side artifact block: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-runner/pull/412 (WIP) :thumbsup:
Liam: I pushed a redaction patch that falls back to token-hash when tokenizer errors: https://github.com/redwood-inference/preproc/commit/9f3a2b7
Anika: created internal ticket EVAL-873 to ACL + purge + retention review. linking here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/EVAL-873
Eval-ci-bot: created issue EVAL-873 and attached run logs.
Maya: action items recap — (1) Liam merge fallback patch, (2) Anika provision ACL + purge + retention check, (3) Derek add artifact-scan tests to eval-ci, (4) Maya re-run sanitized sweep and report. ETA EOD PST?
Derek: I'll add the tests and a dashboard alert `eval.redaction.failures > 0` -> notify #eng-security.
Liam: also adding a small integration test that runs quantized models with `--safe-mode` to catch any quantization-specific tokenizer regressions.
Maya: thanks team. after patches land I'll re-run the failing onboard jobs in a blocked bucket and post sanitized outputs. :lock:
